Biweekly National Respiratory Virus Sentinel Surveillance Report
Epidemiological Week 25 & 26 (June 15 - 28, 2026)
In week 25, the influenza positivity rate was recorded at 34.1 % (53 cases), while in week 26 slightly increased
influenza activity with positivity rate of 40.1 % (59 cases).
A total of 311 respiratory samples were tested for Influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV using real-time RT-PCR.
This includes 116 samples of Influenza-like Illness (ILI), 50 samples of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection
(SARI) and 33 samples of extended SARI (eSARI).
A total of 5 SARS-CoV-2, 10 RSV-A and 6 RSV-B were detected during the weeks.
All sentinnel sites have reported SARI and ILI except Punakha and Samdrup Jongkhar Hospitals have not
report ILI for week 26.
